sonnet.problem: The right answer, 'Cut him off from his people', was already shown on cards 6 and 10 as the LORD's consequence for the Molech worshipper. Card 12 asks the same line again for mediums and spiritists. The baker can pick it from the earlier cards without reasoning about verse 6.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The card says the other nations live in the land 'right now'. The text only says the LORD is driving out nations before Israel, and gives no 'right now'.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
